name: @intellectual-frontiers/integrations-fhir
description: The FHIR plugin of Integrations: R4 and US Core as registry entries with their licence as data, a codec for FHIR JSON and NDJSON to the abstract typed tree, a loader of StructureDefinitions, CodeSystems and ValueSets the user supplies, and the acknowledgement port of OperationOutcome.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
